```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(sf)
  library(sfnetworks)
  library(here)
  library(glue)
  library(leaflet)
  library(plotly)
  library(htmltools)
  library(scales)
})
source(here::here("scripts", "00_utils.R"))

# CARTO basemaps require an API key (free for non-commercial use: https://carto.com/basemaps/apikey).
# Set CARTO_API_KEY in .Renviron. Note the key ends up in the rendered HTML, as with any browser tile key.
carto_api_key <- Sys.getenv("CARTO_API_KEY")
if (!nzchar(carto_api_key)) {
  stop("CARTO_API_KEY is not set. Request a key at https://carto.com/basemaps/apikey and add it to .Renviron.")
}

add_carto_tiles <- function(map, variant = "voyager_nolabels") {
  addTiles(
    map,
    urlTemplate = glue("https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/{variant}/{{z}}/{{x}}/{{y}}{{r}}.png?key={carto_api_key}"),
    attribution = '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors &copy; <a href="https://carto.com/attributions">CARTO</a>',
    options = tileOptions(maxZoom = 20)
  )
}
```

```{r optional-pipeline, eval=FALSE}
# Run this once after placing the MARTA GTFS zip in data_raw/gtfs/
source(here::here("scripts", "99_run_all.R"))
```

```{r load-outputs}
    pct_zero_vehicle_label = percent(pct_zero_vehicle / 100, accuracy = 0.1)

atlanta_area_ll <- if (!is.null(nsa_layer)) {

} else {

}

collapse_stop_points <- function(sf_data, group_cols) {
  sf_data %>%
    mutate(.geom = geometry) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
    left_join(
      sf_data %>%
        mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
        select(row_id, geometry),
      by = "row_id"
    ) %>%
    st_as_sf() %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_cols))) %>%
    summarise(n_gtfs_stops = n(), do_union = TRUE, .groups = "drop") %>%
    st_point_on_surface()
}

bus_stops_vis <- collapse_stop_points(bus_stops_ll, "stop_name")

walk_edges <- sf::st_as_sf(walk_net, "edges")

    shape_id = df$shape_id[[1]],
    geometry = st_sfc(st_linestring(as.matrix(shape_points[, c("shape_pt_lon", "shape_pt_lat")])), crs = 4326)

extract_walk_path <- function(network, from_sf, to_sf, label_text = "Walk path") {
  node_sf <- st_as_sf(network, "nodes")
  edge_sf <- st_as_sf(network, "edges")
  from_proj <- st_transform(from_sf[1, ], st_crs(node_sf))
  to_proj <- st_transform(to_sf[1, ], st_crs(node_sf))
  from_idx <- st_nearest_feature(from_proj, node_sf)
  to_idx <- st_nearest_feature(to_proj, node_sf)
  path_obj <- suppressWarnings(
    sfnetworks::st_network_paths(network, from = from_idx, to = to_idx, weights = "weight")
  )
  edge_idx <- path_obj$edge_paths[[1]]

  if (!length(edge_idx)) {
    return(
      st_sf(
        path_label = label_text,
        geometry = st_nearest_points(st_transform(from_proj, 4326), st_transform(to_proj, 4326))
      )
    )
  }

  edge_sf %>%
    slice(edge_idx) %>%
    st_transform(4326) %>%
    mutate(path_label = label_text)
}

# Counts of destinations reachable within 20/30/45 min are produced upstream by
# 06_summarize_metrics.R and carried on tracts_final. Here we only fill any missing
# counts with 0 and derive the bus-vs-rail difference columns used by the maps.
tracts_leaflet <- tracts_leaflet %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(rail_only_n_20, bus_rail_n_20, rail_only_n_30, bus_rail_n_30, rail_only_n_45, bus_rail_n_45),
      ~replace_na(., 0)
    ),
    diff_n_20 = bus_rail_n_20 - rail_only_n_20,
    diff_n_30 = bus_rail_n_30 - rail_only_n_30,
    diff_n_45 = bus_rail_n_45 - rail_only_n_45
  )

summary_reachability <- tracts_leaflet %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  summarise(
    rail_only_n_20 = mean(rail_only_n_20, na.rm = TRUE),
    rail_only_n_30 = mean(rail_only_n_30, na.rm = TRUE),
    rail_only_n_45 = mean(rail_only_n_45, na.rm = TRUE),
    bus_rail_n_20 = mean(bus_rail_n_20, na.rm = TRUE),
    bus_rail_n_30 = mean(bus_rail_n_30, na.rm = TRUE),
    bus_rail_n_45 = mean(bus_rail_n_45, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  separate(metric, into = c("scenario", "threshold"), sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)") %>%
  mutate(
    scenario = recode(
      scenario,
      rail_only_n = "Rail only",
      bus_rail_n = "Bus + rail"
    ),
    threshold = recode(threshold, `20` = "<= 20 min", `30` = "<= 30 min", `45` = "<= 45 min")
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = threshold, values_from = value)

make_popup_html <- function(data, value_col, label) {
  glue_data(
    data,
    "<strong>Tract:</strong> {NAME}<br/>",
    "<strong>{label}:</strong> {ifelse(is.na(.data[[value_col]]), 'Not reachable', round(.data[[value_col]], 1))}<br/>",
    "<strong>Median income:</strong> {hhinc_label}<br/>",
    "<strong>Minority share:</strong> {pct_minority_label}<br/>",
    "<strong>Zero-vehicle HH:</strong> {pct_zero_vehicle_label}"
  )
}

add_reference_destination_markers <- function(map_obj, data) {
  icon_map <- c(
    job_center = "briefcase",
    education = "graduation-cap",
    hospital = "plus-square",
    airport = "plane"
  )

  marker_map <- c(
    job_center = "darkblue",
    education = "darkpurple",
    hospital = "pink",
    airport = "orange"
  )

  for (type_name in names(icon_map)) {
    type_data <- data %>% filter(dest_type == type_name)
    if (!nrow(type_data)) next

    map_obj <- map_obj %>%
      addAwesomeMarkers(
        data = type_data,
        icon = awesomeIcons(
          icon = icon_map[[type_name]],
          iconColor = "white",
          library = "fa",
          markerColor = marker_map[[type_name]]
        ),
        label = ~dest_name,
        popup = ~glue("<strong>{dest_name}</strong><br/>{dest_type}"),
        group = "Destinations"
      )
  }

  map_obj
}

add_thematic_destination_markers <- function(map_obj, data) {
  for (type_name in names(dest_marker_colors)) {
    type_data <- data %>% filter(dest_type == type_name)
    if (!nrow(type_data)) next

    map_obj <- map_obj %>%
      addCircleMarkers(
        data = type_data,
        radius = 2,
        stroke = TRUE,
        weight = 0.7,
        color = "#ffffff",
        fillColor = dest_marker_colors[[type_name]],
        fillOpacity = 0.9,
        label = ~dest_name,
        popup = ~glue("<strong>{dest_name}</strong><br/>{dest_type}"),
        group = "Destinations"
      )
  }

  map_obj
}

make_swatch_legend_html <- function(title, colors, labels) {
  HTML(
    paste0(
      "<div style='background: rgba(255,255,255,0.96); padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #d0d0d0;'>",
      "<div style='font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 8px;'>", title, "</div>",
      paste0(
        "<div style='margin-bottom: 4px;'><span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:",
        colors,
        ";margin-right:8px;vertical-align:middle;'></span>",
        labels,
        "</div>",
        collapse = ""
      ),
      "</div>"
    )
  )
}

make_component_legend_html <- function(title, items) {
  entry_html <- purrr::pmap_chr(items, function(type, color, label) {
    symbol <- if (type == "line") {
      paste0(
        "<span style='display:inline-block;width:18px;height:0;border-top:3px solid ",
        color,
        ";margin-right:8px;vertical-align:middle;'></span>"
      )
    } else {
      paste0(
        "<span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:",
        color,
        ";border-radius:50%;margin-right:8px;vertical-align:middle;'></span>"
      )
    }

    paste0("<div style='margin-bottom: 4px;'>", symbol, label, "</div>")
  })

  HTML(
    paste0(
      "<div style='background: rgba(255,255,255,0.96); padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #d0d0d0;'>",
      "<div style='font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 8px;'>", title, "</div>",
      paste0(entry_html, collapse = ""),
      "</div>"
    )
  )
}

make_demographic_map <- function(sf_data, value_col, label, palette_colors) {
  value_fmt <- if (value_col == "hhinc") {
    function(x) dollar(x)
  } else {
    function(x) percent(x / 100, accuracy = 0.1)
  }

  viz_data <- sf_data %>%
    mutate(
      metric_value = .data[[value_col]],
      popup_html = glue(
        "<strong>Tract:</strong> {NAME}<br/>",
        "<strong>{label}:</strong> {value_fmt(metric_value)}<br/>",
        "<strong>Median income:</strong> {hhinc_label}<br/>",
        "<strong>Minority share:</strong> {pct_minority_label}<br/>",
        "<strong>Zero-vehicle HH:</strong> {pct_zero_vehicle_label}"
      )
    )

  pal <- colorNumeric(palette = palette_colors, domain = viz_data$metric_value, na.color = "#d9d9d9")

  leaflet(viz_data, options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = TRUE, minZoom = 9)) %>%
    add_carto_tiles() %>%
    addPolygons(
      fillColor = ~pal(metric_value),
      fillOpacity = 0.84,
      color = "#faf7f2",
      weight = 0.5,
      popup = ~popup_html,
      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#111111", bringToFront = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    addLegend(
      pal = pal,
      values = viz_data$metric_value,
      title = label,
      position = "bottomright",
      opacity = 0.9
    )
}

make_leaflet_map <- function(sf_data, value_col, palette_colors, label, popup_col = value_col, bins = NULL, legend_title = label, legend_labels = NULL, marker_mode = c("none", "circles")) {
  marker_mode <- match.arg(marker_mode)
  viz_data <- sf_data %>%
    mutate(
      metric_value = .data[[value_col]],
      popup_value = .data[[popup_col]],
      popup_html = glue(
        "<strong>Tract:</strong> {NAME}<br/>",
        "<strong>{label}:</strong> {ifelse(is.na(popup_value), 'Not reachable', round(popup_value, 1))}<br/>",
        "<strong>Median income:</strong> {hhinc_label}<br/>",
        "<strong>Minority share:</strong> {pct_minority_label}<br/>",
        "<strong>Zero-vehicle HH:</strong> {pct_zero_vehicle_label}"
      )
    )
  vals <- viz_data$metric_value
  pal <- if (is.null(bins)) {
    colorNumeric(palette = palette_colors, domain = vals, na.color = "#d9d9d9")
  } else {
    colorBin(palette = palette_colors, domain = vals, bins = bins, na.color = "#d9d9d9", pretty = FALSE)
  }

  map_obj <- leaflet(viz_data, options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = TRUE, minZoom = 9)) %>%
    add_carto_tiles() %>%
    addPolygons(
      fillColor = ~pal(metric_value),
      fillOpacity = 0.82,
      color = "#f8f5f0",
      weight = 0.5,
      smoothFactor = 0.2,
      popup = ~popup_html,
      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#111111", bringToFront = TRUE)
    )

  if (marker_mode == "circles") {
    map_obj <- add_thematic_destination_markers(map_obj, destinations_ll)
  }

  if (is.null(legend_labels)) {
    map_obj <- map_obj %>%
      addLegend(
        pal = pal,
        values = vals,
        title = legend_title,
        position = "bottomright",
        opacity = 0.9
      )
  } else {
    legend_colors <- unname(pal(c(0, 1, 3, 5)[seq_along(legend_labels)]))
    map_obj <- map_obj %>%
      addControl(
        make_swatch_legend_html(legend_title, legend_colors, legend_labels),
        position = "bottomright"
      )
  }

  map_obj
}

make_toggle_tt_map <- function(sf_data, rail_col, bus_col, title_prefix, palette_colors, bins, marker_mode = c("none", "circles")) {
  marker_mode <- match.arg(marker_mode)
  map_obj <- leaflet(options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 9)) %>%
    add_carto_tiles()

  shared_domain <- c(sf_data[[rail_col]], sf_data[[bus_col]])
  shared_pal <- colorBin(
    palette = palette_colors,
    domain = shared_domain,
    bins = bins,
    na.color = "#d9d9d9",
    pretty = FALSE
  )

  layer_specs <- list(
    list(col = rail_col, label = glue("{title_prefix}: Rail only")),
    list(col = bus_col, label = glue("{title_prefix}: Bus + rail"))
  )

  for (spec in layer_specs) {
    group_data <- sf_data %>%
      mutate(
        metric_value = .data[[spec$col]],
        popup_html = glue(
          "<strong>Tract:</strong> {NAME}<br/>",
          "<strong>{spec$label}:</strong> {ifelse(is.na(metric_value), 'Not reachable', round(metric_value, 1))}<br/>",
          "<strong>Median income:</strong> {hhinc_label}<br/>",
          "<strong>Minority share:</strong> {pct_minority_label}<br/>",
          "<strong>Zero-vehicle HH:</strong> {pct_zero_vehicle_label}"
        )
      )

    map_obj <- map_obj %>%
      addPolygons(
        data = group_data,
        fillColor = ~shared_pal(metric_value),
        fillOpacity = 0.84,
        color = "#faf7f2",
        weight = 0.5,
        popup = ~popup_html,
        group = spec$label,
        highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#111111", bringToFront = TRUE)
      )
  }

  map_obj %>%
    {if (marker_mode == "circles") add_thematic_destination_markers(., destinations_ll %>% filter(dest_name == "Midtown")) else .} %>%
    addLegend(
      pal = shared_pal,
      values = shared_domain,
      title = title_prefix,
      position = "bottomright",
      opacity = 0.9
    ) %>%
    addLayersControl(
      baseGroups = purrr::map_chr(layer_specs, "label"),
      overlayGroups = "Destinations",
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE),
      position = "topleft"
    )
}

make_threshold_toggle_map <- function(sf_data, columns, scenario_label, palette_colors, bins, legend_labels, marker_mode = c("none", "circles")) {
  marker_mode <- match.arg(marker_mode)
  map_obj <- leaflet(options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 9)) %>%
    add_carto_tiles()

  layer_specs <- tibble(
    col = columns,
    threshold = c("<= 20 min", "<= 30 min", "<= 45 min"),
    label = glue("{scenario_label}: {threshold}")
  )

  shared_domain <- unlist(sf_data[columns], use.names = FALSE)
  shared_pal <- colorBin(
    palette = palette_colors,
    domain = shared_domain,
    bins = bins,
    na.color = "#d9d9d9",
    pretty = FALSE
  )

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(layer_specs))) {
    spec <- layer_specs[i, ]
    group_data <- sf_data %>%
      mutate(
        metric_value = .data[[spec$col[[1]]]],
        popup_html = glue(
          "<strong>Tract:</strong> {NAME}<br/>",
          "<strong>{spec$label[[1]]}:</strong> {ifelse(is.na(metric_value), 'Not reachable', round(metric_value, 1))}<br/>",
          "<strong>Median income:</strong> {hhinc_label}<br/>",
          "<strong>Minority share:</strong> {pct_minority_label}<br/>",
          "<strong>Zero-vehicle HH:</strong> {pct_zero_vehicle_label}"
        )
      )

    map_obj <- map_obj %>%
      addPolygons(
        data = group_data,
        fillColor = ~shared_pal(metric_value),
        fillOpacity = 0.84,
        color = "#faf7f2",
        weight = 0.5,
        popup = ~popup_html,
        group = spec$label[[1]],
        highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#111111", bringToFront = TRUE)
      )
  }

  if (marker_mode == "circles") {
    map_obj <- add_thematic_destination_markers(map_obj, destinations_ll)
  }

  legend_colors <- unname(shared_pal(c(0, 1, 3, 5)))

  map_obj %>%
    addControl(
      make_swatch_legend_html(glue("{scenario_label}: destinations reachable"), legend_colors, legend_labels),
      position = "bottomright"
    ) %>%
    addLayersControl(
      baseGroups = layer_specs$label,
      overlayGroups = if (marker_mode == "circles") "Destinations" else character(0),
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE),
      position = "topleft"
    )
}

make_equity_scatter <- function(data, x_col, x_label, title) {
  plot_data <- data %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(NAME, all_of(x_col), bus_rail_mean_tt) %>%
    rename(x_value = all_of(x_col)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(x_value), !is.na(bus_rail_mean_tt))

  fit <- lm(bus_rail_mean_tt ~ x_value, data = plot_data)
  fit_grid <- tibble(x_value = seq(min(plot_data$x_value), max(plot_data$x_value), length.out = 100)) %>%
    mutate(y_hat = predict(fit, newdata = .))

  plot_ly(
    data = plot_data,
    x = ~x_value,
    y = ~bus_rail_mean_tt,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = list(size = 7, color = "#e0913f", opacity = 0.65),
    text = ~glue("Tract: {NAME}<br>{x_label}: {round(x_value, 1)}<br>Mean travel time: {round(bus_rail_mean_tt, 1)} min"),
    hoverinfo = "text",
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) %>%
    add_lines(
      data = fit_grid,
      x = ~x_value,
      y = ~y_hat,
      line = list(color = "#7f2704", width = 2),
      inherit = FALSE,
      hoverinfo = "skip",
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
    layout(
      title = title,
      xaxis = list(title = x_label),
      yaxis = list(title = "Bus + rail mean travel time (min)", tickvals = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 45, 60))
    ) %>%
    layout(plotly_theme)
}

plotly_theme <- list(
  paper_bgcolor = "#f6f2ea",
  plot_bgcolor = "#f6f2ea",
  font = list(color = "#1d1d1b", family = "Georgia"),
  xaxis = list(gridcolor = "#d9d2c3", zerolinecolor = "#d9d2c3"),
  yaxis = list(gridcolor = "#d9d2c3", zerolinecolor = "#d9d2c3")
)
```

# Overview

::: {.callout}
**Goal:** Measure how well MARTA's multimodal transit network connects Atlanta census tracts to `r n_destinations` key points of interest (job centers, universities, hospitals, and the airport), and whether access gaps fall on higher-need neighborhoods.

**Approach:** Compare scheduled weekday-morning-peak travel times from each of `r n_tracts` tracts under two scenarios, rail only and bus + rail. Relate the results to median household income, percent minority, and percent zero-vehicle households.
:::

<div class="stat-tiles">
<div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-value">`r fmt2(rail_n20)` → `r fmt2(bus_n20)`</div><div class="stat-label">Average destinations reachable within 20 min, rail only → bus + rail</div></div>
<div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-value">`r fmt2(bus_n45)` of `r n_destinations`</div><div class="stat-label">Average destinations reachable within 45 min, bus + rail</div></div>
</div>

# Data and Tools

<table class="data-table">
<thead><tr><th>Source</th><th>What it provides</th><th>Used for</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td><strong>Census and ACS</strong><br>(`r acs_year` 5-year)</td><td><ul><li>Tract boundaries (`r n_tracts` tracts inside City of Atlanta neighborhoods)</li><li>Median household income, percent minority, percent zero-vehicle households</li></ul></td><td>Analysis geography and equity indicators</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>MARTA GTFS</strong></td><td><ul><li>Rail lines, bus routes, stations, stops</li><li>Weekday schedules</li></ul></td><td>Transit network and scheduled travel times</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>OpenStreetMap</strong></td><td><ul><li>Walkable streets and paths</li></ul></td><td>Walk legs to and from transit</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Destination layer</strong></td><td><ul>`r destination_list_html`</ul></td><td>Destinations whose access is measured</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**Tools:** R (tidyverse, sf, sfnetworks, tidytransit, tidycensus, leaflet, plotly, scales)

# Methods

1. **Clip to study area:** OSM streets and paths are clipped to the study tracts plus a 3 km buffer, so walks near the city edge are not cut off.
2. **Process walk network:** keep pedestrian-relevant types (footways, paths, residential and local streets, primary to tertiary roads), remove motorways and trunk roads, and build a routable network with `sfnetworks` weighted by segment length.
3. **Origins:** one centroid per tract.
4. **Walk links:** shortest path on the walk network from each centroid to stops within 800 m (0.5 mi, about 10 min). Destinations link to their nearby stops the same way.
5. **Transit schedules:** GTFS service limited to the weekday morning peak (7–10 AM), split into rail only and bus + rail.
6. **Transit routing:** fastest scheduled trip from each tract's linked stops to each destination's stops, with up to 3 transfers.
7. **Door-to-door time:** walk to stop + transit + walk from stop.
8. **Metrics:** destinations reachable within 20, 30, and 45 min, and mean travel time.

<details>
<summary>Code excerpt: walking network (<code>scripts/03_prepare_walking_network.R</code>)</summary>

```r
walk_lines <- read_osm_layer("lines") %>%
  # Retain only pedestrian-relevant road types.
  filter(highway %in% c(
    "footway", "path", "pedestrian", "living_street", "residential",
    "service", "unclassified", "tertiary", "secondary", "primary"
  )) %>%
  st_transform(study_crs) %>%
  # Clip to the study area plus a 3 km buffer.
  st_intersection(tracts_acs %>% st_union() %>% st_buffer(3000)) %>%
  st_cast("LINESTRING", warn = FALSE)

# Build an undirected walk network weighted by segment length in meters.
walk_net <- walk_lines %>%
  sfnetworks::as_sfnetwork(directed = FALSE) %>%
  activate(edges) %>%
  mutate(weight = as.numeric(st_length(geometry)))
```

</details>

Transit routing uses `tidytransit::raptor()`, an R implementation of the established RAPTOR algorithm that routes directly on GTFS timetables and transfers.

<details>
<summary>Code excerpt: RAPTOR routing (<code>scripts/05_compute_accessibility.R</code>)</summary>

```r
# Find the fastest scheduled trips from the stops within walking distance of a tract.
raptor_res <- tidytransit::raptor(
  stop_times = stop_times_obj,
  transfers = attr(stop_times_obj, "transfers"),
  stop_ids = candidate_stops$stop_id,
  time_range = peak_time_range,
  max_transfers = max_transfers,
  keep = "all"
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  # Add the walk from the tract centroid to the boarding stop.
  left_join(
    candidate_stops %>% select(stop_id, walk_time_min),
    by = c("from_stop_id" = "stop_id")
  ) %>%
  mutate(total_time_min = seconds_to_minutes(travel_time) + walk_time_min)
```

</details>

# Results

## Accessibility

Destinations reachable from each tract, averaged across tracts. Click any tract for values.

```{r reachability-summary}
summary_reachability %>%
  mutate(
    `<= 20 min` = sprintf("%.2f", `<= 20 min`),
    `<= 30 min` = if_else(scenario == "Rail only", "—", sprintf("%.2f", `<= 30 min`)),
    `<= 45 min` = if_else(scenario == "Rail only", "—", sprintf("%.2f", `<= 45 min`))
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Scenario", "<= 20 min", "<= 30 min", "<= 45 min"),
    align = c("l", "r", "r", "r")
  )
```

Every rail-only trip completes within 20 min, so one threshold covers all rail-reachable destinations.

```{r map-demographics}
  tagList(
    tags$h4("Median household income"),
    income_map,
    tags$h4("Percent minority"),
    minority_map,
    tags$h4("Percent zero-vehicle households"),
    zero_vehicle_map
  )
)
```

```{r equity-scatterplots}
subplot(
  make_equity_scatter(tracts_leaflet, "hhinc", "Median household income", "Travel time vs income"),
  make_equity_scatter(tracts_leaflet, "pct_minority", "Percent minority", "Travel time vs percent minority"),
  make_equity_scatter(tracts_leaflet, "pct_zero_vehicle", "Percent zero-vehicle households", "Travel time vs zero-vehicle households"),
  nrows = 1,
  margin = 0.04,
  shareY = TRUE
 ) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Mean travel time vs socioeconomic indicators",
    xaxis = list(title = "Median household income"),
    xaxis2 = list(title = "Percent minority"),
    xaxis3 = list(title = "Percent zero-vehicle households")
  )
```

```{r equity-boxplot}
income_box_data <- tracts_leaflet %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(bus_rail_mean_tt), !is.na(hhinc)) %>%
  mutate(income_quartile = factor(ntile(hhinc, 4), labels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4")))

minority_box_data <- tracts_leaflet %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(bus_rail_mean_tt), !is.na(pct_minority)) %>%
  mutate(minority_quartile = factor(ntile(pct_minority, 4), labels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4")))

income_box <- plot_ly(
  data = income_box_data,
  x = ~income_quartile,
  y = ~bus_rail_mean_tt,
  type = "box",
  color = I("#a85217"),
  boxpoints = "all",
  jitter = 0.2,
  pointpos = 0,
  marker = list(color = "#a85217", opacity = 0.55, size = 5),
  line = list(color = "#7f2704"),
  hovertext = ~glue("Tract: {NAME}<br>Income quartile: {income_quartile}<br>Mean travel time: {round(bus_rail_mean_tt, 1)} min"),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  showlegend = FALSE
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Mean travel time by income quartile",
    xaxis = list(title = "Income quartile"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Bus + rail mean travel time (min)")
  ) %>%
  layout(plotly_theme)

minority_box <- plot_ly(
  data = minority_box_data,
  x = ~minority_quartile,
  y = ~bus_rail_mean_tt,
  type = "box",
  color = I("#fdc38d"),
  boxpoints = "all",
  jitter = 0.2,
  pointpos = 0,
  marker = list(color = "#fdc38d", opacity = 0.55, size = 5),
  line = list(color = "#c9701f"),
  hovertext = ~glue("Tract: {NAME}<br>Minority quartile: {minority_quartile}<br>Mean travel time: {round(bus_rail_mean_tt, 1)} min"),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  showlegend = FALSE
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Mean travel time by percent-minority quartile",
    xaxis = list(title = "Percent-minority quartile"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Bus + rail mean travel time (min)")
  ) %>%
  layout(plotly_theme)

subplot(income_box, minority_box, nrows = 1, margin = 0.05, shareY = TRUE) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Mean travel time by income and percent-minority quartiles",
    xaxis = list(title = "Income quartile"),
    xaxis2 = list(title = "Percent-minority quartile")
  )
```

## Key Findings

- **Bus service gives roughly `r sprintf("%.1f", bus_n20 / rail_n20)`x rail-only access:** average destinations within 20 min rises from `r fmt2(rail_n20)` to `r fmt2(bus_n20)`, so a rail-only view understates access, especially outside rail corridors.
- **Access is still limited:** even at 45 min, the average tract reaches `r fmt2(bus_n45)` of `r n_destinations` destinations (`r fmt2(bus_n30)` at 30 min).
- **Equity pattern:** longer trips tend to fall on lower-income and higher-minority tracts, clearest for percent minority and weaker for zero-vehicle households.
- **Real gap vs. data artifact:** Emory and Piedmont Atlanta Hospital lack nearby rail. Hartsfield's station is not georeferenced inside the airport tract, so airport rail access is understated, not absent.

# Limitations

- **Tract centroid:** Each census tract is represented by a single centroid point, so the analysis does not capture within-tract variation in population distribution.
- **Time period:** The analysis is limited to a weekday morning peak period and does not reflect accessibility at other times of day or on weekends.
- **Schedule service data:** Transit travel times are based on scheduled GTFS service and do not reflect real-world operating conditions such as delays, reliability, or crowding.
- **Selective destination layer:** The destination layer is selective and represents only seven destinations rather than broader urban activity patterns.
- **Walking approximation:** The OpenStreetMap walking network is an approximation of pedestrian connectivity and may overstate or understate walk access in some locations.
